definitions.explanation: A Japanese hot pot dish where thinly sliced meat and vegetables are briefly swished in simmering broth and eaten with dipping sauces.

examples.japanese: {今夜|こんや}はしゃぶしゃぶにしよう。
{薄切|うすぎ}りの{肉|にく}をしゃぶしゃぶにした。
examples.english: We had shabu-shabu with thinly sliced meat.

examples.japanese: {冬|ふゆ}は{家族|かぞく}みんなでしゃぶしゃぶを{囲|かこ}むのが{楽|たの}しみだ。
examples.english: In winter, I look forward to gathering around shabu-shabu with the whole family.

notes:
The name しゃぶしゃぶ is onomatopoeia for the sound of swishing thin meat slices back and forth in hot broth.

HOW IT IS EATEN:
Thin slices of beef or pork are briefly dipped in boiling broth (usually kombu-based) until just cooked, then dipped in ponzu or sesame sauce.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- しゃぶしゃぶ{用|よう}の{肉|にく}: meat for shabu-shabu
- しゃぶしゃぶ{鍋|なべ}: shabu-shabu pot
- {豚|ぶた}しゃぶ: pork shabu-shabu

RELATED WORDS:
- すき{焼|や}き: sukiyaki (another hot pot dish, sweeter broth)
- {鍋|なべ}: hot pot (general term)
